summary.text: Joe Ellington is a Republican physician and member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 38, where he has served since 2010, and is seeking re-election against Democrat Randa Faulkner in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Joe Ellington was born in New York and earned a B.S. from Guilford College, an M.S. and Ph.D. from Duke University, and an M.D. from Wake Forest University.
He completed his residency at St. Joseph Mercy Hospital in Ann Arbor, Michigan, and has worked as a physician.
Ellington chaired the House Education Committee in the 2023-2024 session and also served on the Banking and Insurance, Finance, Rules and Workforce Development committees.
